"""Diagnostic only: exercise existing production callbacks, not a migrated fixture."""
import asyncio
from dataclasses import replace
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile

import httpx
from fastapi import FastAPI


async def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="bff-auth-seam-") as temporary:
        os.environ.update(BFF_DATA_DIR=temporary, PANTHEON_BFF_AUTH_STUB="true",
                          PANTHEON_BFF_AUTH_MODE="permissive",
                          RANKING_STORE_DSN="postgresql://test:test@127.0.0.1:1/test",
                          RANKING_STORE_BOOTSTRAP="0")
        from services.control_plane.bff import main as composition
        from services.control_plane.bff.auth.handlers import create_auth_handlers
        from services.control_plane.bff.auth.router import create_auth_router
        from services.control_plane.bff.auth.service import AuthFacadeService
        from services.control_plane.bff.session_lifecycle_store import SessionLifecycleStore

        results = {}
        for label, store in (
            ("composition_store", composition.auth_deps.session_lifecycle_store),
            ("isolated_store", SessionLifecycleStore(str(Path(temporary) / "isolated.json"))),
        ):
            deps = replace(composition.auth_deps, session_lifecycle_store=store)
            handlers = create_auth_handlers(dependencies=deps)
            app = FastAPI()
            app.include_router(create_auth_router(service=AuthFacadeService(
                local_readiness=handlers["bff_auth_readiness"], handlers=handlers)))
            headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer seam-probe-{label}:operator"}
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app),
                                         base_url="http://synthetic.test") as client:
                before = await client.get("/bff/me", headers=headers)
                logout = await client.post("/bff/logout", headers=headers)
                after = await client.get("/bff/me", headers=headers)
            results[label] = {"before": before.status_code, "logout": logout.status_code,
                              "after": after.status_code,
                              "guard_module": deps.raise_if_session_logged_out.__module__,
                              "store_matches_guard_global": store is composition.session_lifecycle_store}
        print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
        assert results["composition_store"]["after"] == 401
        # Regression expectation: the same real guard must follow the injected store.
        assert results["isolated_store"]["after"] == 401, "logout guard reads composition global instead of injected store"


asyncio.run(main())
